raw:
Professor Stone’s fingers ease off the book, though he does not yet slide it across the table.

“That is scarcely an orientation,” he says. “It is a summons.”

He taps the four-page human chapter in your arcana survey.

“This will teach you the Academy’s version of why the human seat is empty. It will not tell you much about what a Garvey was expected to do when the seat was occupied.”

He opens the brown volume to a marked page. The first heading reads: **THE HUMAN SEAT: MEDIATION, RECORD, AND CONSENT**.

“My seminar begins there. Read the first section before Thursday. It is dry, but at least it is dry honestly.”

For a moment he studies you over the rim of his spectacles, the card game’s laughter faint through the wall.

“When the lawyers contacted you, what did you ask them?”
